name: meta-skills
description: Disposable meta-skills that build a project's agent harness, then get removed.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: The required set: enough to take any project from no harness to a working one, including the removal skill.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Design description and visual language for projects with a user-facing frontend. Install on top of core.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Trusted defaults and doc URLs for Python targets: docstring and comment conventions, testing setup, and toolchain choices. Install on top of core.

plugins.name: machine-learning
plugins.description: Authoritative documentation entry points for ML projects, one skill per domain; information only, never recommendations. Install on top of core.

plugins.name: data-science
plugins.description: Authoritative documentation entry points for data-analysis and scientific-computing projects, one skill per domain; information only, never recommendations. Install on top of core.
